title: Telugu language and alphabet
notable_features: Type of writing system: Abugida / Syllabic Alphabet in which all consonants have an inherent vowel. Diacritics, which can appear above, below, before or after the consonant they belong to, are used to change the inherent vowel.
When they appear the the beginning of a syllable, vowels are written as independent letters.
When certain consonants occur together, special conjunct symbols are used which combine the essential parts of each letter.
Writing direction: left to right in horizontal lines
